# Real Solutions

> Real Solutions is a senior AI engineering studio. Two architects with AI leverage, shipping production-grade AI systems in weeks — with guarantees you can audit. We build for three international audiences: pre-seed/seed startup founders who need a production AI MVP shipped fast, regulated enterprise teams (fintech, healthcare, proptech) who need AI systems that survive a compliance review, and agencies and CTOs who need a senior engineering pod to subcontract to. Every engagement is scoped, built, and reviewed by the same two senior architects — never handed off to a bench of juniors.

## Key facts

- Company: Real Solutions
- Founders: Ervin Piol and Kairus Noah Tecson — former lead full-stack engineers and heads of engineering at an AI startup. Two senior architects, not a team of juniors managed by a senior.
- Differentiator: provable engineering guarantees, not demos — a grounding guard that rejects any model output citing a number the deterministic engine didn't produce; server-side citations built only from chunks actually retrieved; tenant isolation enforced at the database layer via Postgres row-level security with a bleed-guard; honest "we don't know" instead of a guess; every deviation from spec recorded as a numbered ADR.
- Engagement model: managed AI engineering partner (not staff augmentation or freelancers); clients own their code and data
- Process: three build weeks → one UAT week against real users → hypercare → 30-day warranty
- Contact: executives.realsolutions.ph@gmail.com

## Services

- [AI Agents & RAG](https://www.realsolutionsph.com/services/ai-software-development): Production RAG systems and LLM agents with grounded output, server-side citations, and provable tenant isolation. Flagship service. From $5,000 (2–4 weeks) for a single feature add-on.
- [System Integration](https://www.realsolutionsph.com/services/system-integration): Wiring AI agents and RAG pipelines into the APIs, databases, and internal tools a team already runs — not a bolt-on chatbot. From $3,500 (2–4 weeks).
- [Custom Platforms](https://www.realsolutionsph.com/services/custom-software): Multi-tenant platform engineering with tenant isolation enforced at the database layer, not an app-layer check. From $13,000 (6–10 weeks).
- [Web & Mobile](https://www.realsolutionsph.com/services/web-mobile-apps): Front-ends and apps built for what's running behind them — streamed tokens and citations rendered live, one React Native codebase for iOS and Android. From $3,000 (1–3 weeks).
- [Voice AI](https://www.realsolutionsph.com/services/voice-ai): Voice agents with real barge-in, one agent core across chat and calls, and cost caps built in from day one. From $5,000 (4 weeks).
- [Data Pipelines](https://www.realsolutionsph.com/services/data-pipelines): Deterministic-first data pipelines with full lineage, using an LLM only where deterministic logic can't reach. From $13,000 (6–10 weeks).
- [AI MVP Development](https://www.realsolutionsph.com/services/ai-mvp-development): A production AI system in front of real users in four weeks — the startup audience's primary path. From $5,000 (4 weeks).
